task: OLD PHOTO (generated) + TEXT -> DIFFERENT HIGH-RES RESTORATIONS
design: ONE shared synthetically-aged old-photo input -> K=4 different high-res restoration targets; text is the ONLY disambiguating signal
why_self_built: no public dataset combines old-photo damage, text instructions and multiple aligned HQ targets; real historical photos have no clean GT
benchmarks: Wan et al., CVPR 2020 (structured/unstructured old-photo defects)
RealOld / Pik-Fix, WACV 2023 (200 real old photos, 1 GT each)
GGT-100K, 2026 (generative GT, Old Photo 6,105 pairs, 1 GT each)

gt_pool.note: SD + Prompt-to-Prompt generated, NOT real photographs

anti_confound: the OLD-PHOTO input is IDENTICAL for all K targets
the shared x always has a colour cast, grain AND scratches, so the desired restoration style cannot be read from the image
style phrase is in the FIRST words of every prompt
caption (official original_prompt) and constraints are independent of the target id
honesty: x is a synthetically aged generated photograph, not a digitized historical print
y0 is the official GT; y1..y3 are deterministic tone transforms of y0, not independent expert restorations
validates text-selected restoration, NOT restoration quality, language understanding or real user preference
